Hunter System Rules

◆ Earn XP by completing quizzes, study sessions, habits and challenges.
◆ Every 100 XP advances you by one level. XP carries forward after each level.
◆ Your rank is determined automatically by your current level. Reaching a new rank threshold triggers a Rank Up window.
◆ Your progress is saved in this browser.

Multiplayer is learning-only. Game chat is available inside a challenge, but do not share phone numbers, addresses, links, photos, or real-world meeting requests.
